project.description: Encryption and keys (plain Java, no Spring, no runtime dependencies): the key service plug-in point (Vault Transit now; AWS KMS and Azure Key Vault later), separate keys per customer, AES-256-GCM envelope encryption of values and streams with data keys wrapped by the key service, key versions and rotation, keyed fingerprints (HMAC-SHA256 in the key service) for exact-match search of sensitive values, and a Vault client (Transit and KV, token or AppRole login) with specific failure codes and no secret in any output.
